fixed.explanation: runDaemonForContext binds the browser to a new session name for every context. A second context, for example from a worker-scoped fixture, shares the same browser, so a second bind fails and the test crashes. The edit remembers which browsers are already bound and returns early for later contexts on them, so only the first context binds and pauses. I could not see the caller, so this assumes a false return is handled safely.
